investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ardhollow Goods (online retail); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus (zones eastus-1/eastus-2/eastus-3); network range 10.111.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ardhol-prod-eastus (AKS); Identity/token service token-svc is called synchronously by every API request and is backed by PostgreSQL token-db-01; deployments may bundle database migrations; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
